name: Puffco | Peak Pro 3DXL | Plasma
description:
The Peak Pro Plasma represents the highest level-up for what a cannabis experience can be through technology.

 

Featuring rippling glasswork + an exclusive 3DXL Chamber, crushed opal detailing and a rare finish that flows between violet and ember, this limited edition is an electrified new look for the pinnacle of hash technology.

 

Unlock the fullest potential of the plant with its patented 3DXL Chamber, single-button interface, and deep customization via the Connect app. Completed by the Joystick Cap and laser-cut perc slots for improved water filtration, the Peak Pro delivers incredible flavor and unparalleled performance.
